title: A noncomputable language in layered polynomial size
statement: There is a language $L$ of Boolean strings contained in the language of all-ones strings such that $L$ is recognized by a family of layered circuits using only the specified standard gate operations and having size bounded by a polynomial in the input length, but membership in $L$ is not a computable predicate.
